correctness.rationale: Projection of im X to V/U has dimension s and its kernel is im A+B(ker D), so rank X=r+s+δ and δ=dim((im X∩U)/X(U)) is intrinsic. If XYX=X with Y(U)⊆U then Y must lift im X∩U inside U; conversely when this intersection equals X(U), choose a section with that property and extend it by zero on complementary directions. Thus regularity means δ=0. For fixed A,D, restriction and quotient of B give a surjective linear map onto Hom(ker D,coker A) with kernel dimension ab−(a−r)(b−s). The kernel consists exactly of the sums of maps of forms AT and SD: first extend a lift on ker D into im A, then the residual vanishes on ker D and factors through D. The two triangular shears implement those shifts, and the remaining independent invertible basis changes realize all row and column operations on the quotient rectangle. This proves the unit-orbit classification and finite fiber formula over every prime power. For square nullity i the closed-form probability is bounded by q^(−i²)/P_q by factoring its product ratio into P_n/P_i, P_n/P_(n−i) and 1/P_i, where P_k=∏_(j=1)^k(1−q^(−j)). Thus convergence is in total variation; independence and the common conditional kernel give the full defect law without relative-growth restrictions. The limit regular fraction is strictly positive from a zero nullity and below one from i=j=1 with nonzero quotient map. Independent rational evaluation using P_160 and i,j≤12 gives 0.6998513223055353533 for q=2: the product omission is at most 2^(−160) and the omitted nullity terms are bounded by the summable q^(−i²)/P_q envelope. evidence: The ambient matrix monoid's Bruhat–Renner normal forms are rook matrices, as seen from the diagonal closure of each permutation coset and the Borel double-orbit decomposition. Over a finite field the same normalization is rational: repeatedly take the leftmost nonzero entry of the bottommost nonzero row, clear above by upper triangular row operations and to the right by upper triangular column operations, and recurse.
A rook in the flag monoid has no bottom-left entries, and its numbers of rooks in the top-left, bottom-right and top-right blocks are exactly r,s,δ.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: There is no conjugacy assertion: independently permuting rows and columns within each block gives a single parabolic orbit for each allowed pattern of block rook counts. This is immediate because the rows and columns used by distinct rooks never collide. The triple's invariance under the full units follows from rank on U, rank on V/U and total rank. Thus the specialization of the normal-form framework already classifies the orbits.
